<h1 align="center">CASTAWAY</h1>

<p align="center">
  <b>A ten-hour lo-fi island video in which almost nothing happens, on purpose.</b><br>
  Shown here on a handheld with four shades of green, which the sea, the sand, the palm and she all have to share.
</p>

One young woman in cream headphones, one tall palm, one raft and a great deal of time. She idles, nodding to the music, and every so often something happens: a message in a bottle washes straight back, a drone delivers a parcel that turns out to be another pair of headphones, a coconut lands on a hermit crab and the crab walks off wearing it. Once in a long while she remembers she could leave any time, walks out over the water, and comes back with an iced coffee. The attract mode on that little screen is reporting all of this as it happens. It is not exaggerating.

<p align="center">
  <sub>Working title. An unofficial remake inspired by the small-island routines and visual comedy of <i>Johnny Castaway</i>, the 1992 desert-island screensaver, and not affiliated with it or its owners. Sunny, hand-painted coastal anime for YouTube: 16:9, 1080p at 30 fps, always daytime.</sub>
</p>

```sh
python tools/serve.py    # live preview, MP4 export
# then open http://127.0.0.1:8765/
```

No cartridge and no build step: the renderer is [a web page](web/index.html) of plain ES modules, no npm. It previews live and exports frame-exact H.264 straight out of the browser (WebCodecs, 68 to 78 frames a second at 1080p30 in Chrome), and the server mixes in the sound and joins the two into an MP4. **Every sound is synthesized from code** by [`tools/make_audio.py`](tools/make_audio.py): no samples, no stock loops, no recordings, so no third-party licence applies. It is in development: no video is out yet, and nobody has heard the soundtrack yet, including the code that wrote it.

<details>
<summary><b>INSTRUCTION BOOKLET</b>: how ten hours play out</summary>

```text
 ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 │ CASTAWAY                                  INSTRUCTION BOOKLET    p. 2  │
 │                                                                        │
 │ HOW TO PLAY                                                            │
 │ You don't. She idles, nodding to the music in her headphones. That is  │
 │ most of the video, and it is meant to be.                              │
 │                                                                        │
 │ Four timers run underneath. When one goes off, an activity from its    │
 │ tier starts on the next bar of the music, every 3 seconds, so every    │
 │ gag lands on the beat.                                                 │
 │                                                                        │
 │   TIER          COMES ROUND EVERY     IN A TYPICAL 10-HOUR RUN         │
 │   regular       2 to 5 minutes        about 155                        │
 │   occasional    12 to 25 minutes      about 30                         │
 │   rare          30 to 60 minutes      about 13                         │
 │   super rare    3 to 6 hours          about 2 (3 a run at most)        │
 │   chained       right after another   about 20 follow-ups              │
 │                                                                        │
 │ Lanes let things overlap, so a turtle can visit while she fishes.      │
 │ She is busy about a third of the time. The rest of the time she waits, │
 │ which is what the WAIT button is for. It is the worn one.              │
 │                                                                        │
 │ SAME SEED, SAME VIDEO. Default run: 10:00:00, seed 1992.               │
 │                                                                        │
 │ More than 90 activities in activities.toml (94 on 2026-10-01).         │
 │ Typical counts: median of 200 simulated runs, as the file states.      │
 │ python tools/schedule.py checks the lot and simulates a 10-hour run.   │
 └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</details>

Between those: coconut sipping, fishing, jogging laps, a sandcastle the tide takes, waving for rescue, a sea turtle who visits, and bushcraft (fire by friction, a hammock, a lookout up the palm, spear fishing). The scene keeps itself busy too: shore waves and drifting cloud shadows are built, and birds, planes with vapour trails, whale pods, dolphins, sailboats, sandpipers, a gecko and a rain shower are planned, 26 entries in all.

<summary><b>SPEAKER</b>: what would come out of the grille</summary>

```text
 SPEAKER                                       every sound below is code

 ▶ 00 THEME ........ a seamless 60-second loop at 80 BPM in F major
                     (ii-V-I-vi): 20 bars of exactly 3 seconds, electric
                     piano, kalimba lead, soft drums, vinyl crackle
   01 OCEAN ........ the ambience, also a seamless 60-second loop
   02 THE REST ..... more than 150 files in all, and growing:
                     gulls, splashes, drips, footsteps in sand, a
                     distant ship's horn

   MIX ............. -14 LUFS, true peak at or below -1 dBTP
   LEVELS .......... adjustable in master and per routine
   SAMPLES USED .... 0. Made by tools/make_audio.py, so no licences
   LISTENED TO ..... not yet, by anyone
```

The grille on the bezel is printed on. It has also not heard the soundtrack.
